name: Voxel Association
definition: A mechanism to apply spatial regularizers on SVRaster’s multi-resolution sparse voxel structure by reasoning on a single conceptual finest lattice at resolution G = 2^L, indexed by dL = (i, j, k) ∈ {0, ..., G-1}^3.
summary: Voxel Association enables spatial regularization on sparse voxels by mapping them to a conceptual finest lattice, solving the lack of spatial continuity in sparse grids.
